summary: Status confirmation, no new semantic change expected (no_change). This run is complete with no necessary gaps remaining. Confirmed sourced defect: after a follower installs a snapshot at index S while its persisted log still ends above S, it never accepts the leader's PrevLogEntry=S consistency check and never converges. Cause chain: installSnapshot (raft.go:1814-1953) resets lastApplied/lastSnapshot/configuration and removes or compacts logs at or below req.LastLogIndex but never truncates above it and never calls setLastLog; getLastEntry (state.go:167-174) therefore keeps returning the cached above-snapshot index/term; appendEntries (raft.go:1475-1502) rejects with NoRetryBackoff; replicateTo (replication.go:222-260) walks nextIndex down to ErrLogNotFound and sendLatestSnapshot (replication.go:299-383) re-sends the same snapshot. Retained evidence: CheckRun 2322bd7884b749f89c3101f04bc82e78 shows control holds and the case is violated with valid witness 3; CheckRun ed8023e758ae49bc93676179f4ae489c shows the monotonic-store discriminator also violated with witness 5, so the stall persists even when removeOldLogs already deleted the above-snapshot bytes, pinning the cause on the un-reset cached last-log state rather than retained log bytes. Recorded scope limits: single-process in-memory transport and stores, live catch-up only, progress only with no safety claim, no restart/recovery coverage. Prior interpretations, counterevidence and the earlier unresolved account are preserved. No further experiment or stop declaration is made.
